summary: The Index Support Sync notes for 14 September 2026 list presentation requests and open questions in the index draft spec with suggestions, without recorded outcomes. Kushagra and Anirban's bloom filter index improvements presentation was listed again, with a second entry on Iceberg Puffin index. For index fields the suggestion is three arrays: identity fields, materialized fields and non-materialized fields, using the same expression logic as the proposed non-materialized fields for tables. For sort order the suggestion is a list of field ids, reusing a revamped table sort order definition. The notes' author argues for keeping the index type field. The draft spec pull request was up for review, with a question on whether to open a new pull request or mark the draft ready for review.

topics.title: Presentation requests
topics.summary: Kushagra and Anirban's presentation on bloom filter index improvements was listed, along with a second, truncated entry titled Iceberg Puffin Index vs that links to the same document. The notes record no discussion or outcome.

topics.title: Index fields: identity, materialized and non-materialized
topics.summary: The notes say index fields should use the same expression logic as the proposed non-materialized fields (id plus expression) for tables. The suggestion is three arrays: identity-fields as an int array copied from the table, materialized-fields as (id, expression) pairs stored in the range files, and non-materialized-fields as (id, expression) pairs stored only in the tracking file for every range file. No agreement is recorded.

topics.title: Sort order
topics.summary: If the table sort order definition is revamped for tables, it could be reused for the index spec. The suggestion is a list of field ids covering identity, materialized and non-materialized fields. No agreement is recorded.

topics.title: Keeping the index type field
topics.summary: Whether to keep the index type field came up again during reviews. The author of the notes states a strong belief that the type field should be kept so that future index types can be accommodated. No agreement is recorded.
open_questions: Should the index type field be kept in the spec?

topics.title: Review of the current draft
topics.summary: The draft index spec pull request was listed for review. Because it already has many closed comments, the author asked whether to create a new pull request or move this one from draft to ready for review. The notes record no answer.
open_questions: Should a new pull request be created for the index spec, or should the existing draft be marked ready for review?
